app_identity.name: Lewi House
app_identity.description: Property management platform engineered for professional efficiency and a premium tenant experience.

typography.heading: Playfair Display (font-serif) - use for app headers, prominent numbers, and key titles to inject a boutique hotel vibe.
typography.body: Manrope (font-sans) - clean, geometric, highly legible for data, dashboards, and tables.

visual enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for cards: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]
visual enhancers.borders: Delicate 1px borders using border-[#EAE5D9] on all cards.
visual enhancers.glassmorphism: Bottom navigation MUST use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 with a top border. Never use fully transparent.
visual enhancers.corners: Rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for buttons and badges.

component instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use bg-[#1A362B]. Include active:scale-95 transition.
component instructions.badges: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-widest.
component instructions.cards: Dense, highly padded (p-5), white background with subtle border.
component instructions.inputs: Shadcn standard but override focus ring to focus:ring-[#1A362B]. Background #F4F1EA.
component instructions.bottom_sheet: Use Vaul / Shadcn Drawer for opening tenant details or room details on mobile. (Remember we use .jsx not .tsx)

grids.bento_mobile: For the dashboard, use a 2-column grid (grid-cols-2 gap-4) for metric cards (e.g., Occupancy vs. Outstanding).
grids.lists: Use flex-col gap-4 for vertical lists (rooms, tenants).

layouts.mobile_container: Wrap the entire app in a max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-[#FDFBF7] relative pb-24 shadow-2xl overflow-x-hidden
layouts.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 max-w-md mx-auto bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-[#EAE5D9] flex justify-around items-center pt-3 pb-safe z-50 rounded-t-3xl
layouts.hero_header: Dashboard top should be a relatively positioned block with the property image, a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#111612]/90 to-transparent), and white text on top to convey a premium feel.

motion.lists: Use framer-motion to stagger list items (rooms, tenants) on mount.
motion.tabs: Use framer-motion layoutId for tab active indicator sliding.
motion.interactions: All tap targets must have an active scale down (active:scale-95) and hover colors.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on the hero image overlay meets 4.5:1 ratio. Provide fallback background color.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all interactive icons and buttons in the bottom nav.

media.image_strategy: Use object-cover for room thumbnails (rounded-xl) and property hero. Avatars must be rounded-full.

3d libraries.usage: Not recommended for this specific utility mobile app to preserve battery and performance. Focus on Framer Motion for 2D fluidity.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY .js or .jsx extensions for React components. Do not use .tsx.
Design a mobile PWA. Scaffold the layout inside a centered max-w-md container to simulate a phone on desktop browsers.
Implement a persistent bottom navigation bar (Home, Rooms, Tenants, Bills).
Use Indonesian labels: Beranda (Home), Kamar (Rooms), Penghuni (Tenants), Tagihan (Payments).
Use Recharts for a simple income vs expense bar chart on the Home or Reports view.
In the Dashboard, overlay the property_hero image with a dark gradient and white text for a premium boutique hotel feel.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Apply optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Maintain strict color contrast ratios (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text).
